purpose: Prespecified held-out source episodes after the two-map feasibility run
rule: Two additional original CSV worlds, block and forest, with the same unmodified source runner, start (0,0), goal (100,100), sight radius 20, robot radius 0.5, and 60-iteration cap; retain every decision and every nontrivial skeleton, including source failures
eligibility_rule: Every original skeleton path with more than two vertices
collision_convention: Same point-robot interior-only primary and strict boundary secondary rules as initial benchmark
